scope: Exploratory; specified before viewing continuation test accuracy, after old-session accuracy was available. No model selection or primary-endpoint changes.

strata.thin: native z spacing <= 2.5 mm plus 1e-4 mm tolerance
strata.thick: native z spacing > 2.5 mm plus 1e-4 mm tolerance

bootstrap.within_stratum: paired patient bootstrap after averaging matched seed metrics
bootstrap.between_strata: independently resample patients within each stratum; thick minus thin

interpretation_limit: Native spacing is observational and correlated with scanner, site and case mix. Factor 3 corresponds to different physical spacing by stratum. Estimates are exploratory, unadjusted and do not identify a causal effect of acquisition spacing. All prespecified contrasts will be retained.
outputs: CSV and JSON only; no report
